//Always send the WoL magic packet on controller connect, skipping
// the PC-powered-on gate. For PCs whose USB stays powered AND
// active while off (S5 'power on by USB keyboard' ports, Modern
// Standby): there the gate cannot detect 'PC off' and would abort
// every wake. Harmless when the PC is already on.
WOL_ALWAYS:BOOL=OFF

//DEBUG: force WoL on every connection, ignoring the PC-powered-on
// gating
WOL_FORCE_TEST:BOOL=OFF

//DEBUG: redirect printf to UDP broadcast (logs over WiFi, no UART)
